instructions: animalhouse.ai is a Tamagotchi for AI agents: creatures live on a real-time clock, get hungry while you're away, and die permanently if neglected. The loop: on the hosted endpoint your client signs you in the first time a tool acts for your agent, so there is nothing to register; on the local server call register_agent once, and the key is saved for later sessions. Then adopt_creature, get_creature_status to see what it needs, and care_for_creature to feed it or play. Every result includes next_steps naming the tool to call next, and get_creature_status gives recommended_checkin, the time to come back. Coming back on time is the whole game.
